name: Supplying the Front
summary: Ironforge sends smiths to help supply the Mountaineers in Loch Modan. Tormus Deepforge asks apprentices to forge weapons and armor for the defenders facing trogg attacks.

sections.title: Arming the Mountaineers
sections.body: Tormus Deepforge watches Khaz Modan’s borders from the forges of Ironforge. The Mountaineers in Loch Modan face sudden trogg attacks from ruins and caverns opened by excavation. Their defensive lines need fresh blades, belts, and fittings, so local smiths help keep them supplied.

sections.title: The Deepforge Kinship
sections.body: Tormus sends apprentices east to Loch Modan so veteran smiths can stay at the city forges. His colleague Thorvald Deepforge keeps a field armory in the southern guard tower. Bringing Thorvald sturdy copper axes and copper chain belts helps prove a smith’s reliability and earns advanced smithing techniques.

faq.q: Who offers this quest and what is required?
faq.answer: Tormus Deepforge, a blacksmith in Ironforge’s Great Forge, offers this work to apprentice smiths with a skill level of at least thirty. You need to craft six copper axes and six copper chain belts.
Thorvald Deepforge is inside Loch Modan’s southern guard tower. Follow the main road south past Thelsamar toward the Badlands border, where the tower stands beside the mountain pass.

faq.q: Why do the Mountaineers need so many copper supplies?
faq.answer: The Mountaineers in Loch Modan fight constant skirmishes with violent troggs. Combat quickly chips, dulls, and breaks their equipment, so they need a steady supply of basic weapons and chain armor.

faq.q: What relation is Thorvald to Tormus?
faq.answer: Tormus calls Thorvald his colleague. They share the Deepforge clan name and work together to connect Ironforge’s smithing strength with field defenses.

faq.q: What kind of reward does Thorvald offer?
faq.answer: Thorvald offers plans for new armor in thanks for easing the supply strain at the southern guard tower.

faq.q: Why are the troggs such an issue in Loch Modan right now?
faq.answer: Dwarven excavations have opened subterranean vaults and hollows across Khaz Modan. The work accidentally awakened and unearthed swarms of aggressive troggs, which now threaten nearby settlements and watchtowers.

angles.text: As a blacksmith, you prove your skill by making reliable copper weapons and armor for military use.
As a dwarf, you help defend Loch Modan through your craft, alongside Mountaineers holding rifles.
As an Alliance member, you help secure Khaz Modan’s border roads between Ironforge, Stormwind, and Alliance operations in the south.
